title: Ionized neon made by hand docked at the Crimson War Citadel (Krynn) from neon bought there, sold into its bid, the rest stored
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 18:57 UTC (orders ENT-083, block MERCURY: the traders left at the capitals after the once lines take standing work there, docked NPC-facility crafting; rules F8, F23, O1 zero empty burn). 34 traders wait docked at the Crimson War Citadel after Krynn's once lines (fill.py status trader 18:25 UTC: 64 trader waiting). The Citadel's book (table books, 18:43 UTC): neon_gas asked at 1 cr, ionized_neon bid at 1 cr x 880 (the station's). ionize_neon_gas by hand: 6 neon_gas -> 3 ionized_neon a run; a run costs about 6.1 cr and sells for 3 cr while the bid holds: crafting XP for about 3.1 cr a run, no fuel, no jump. requires.docked_at keeps it to a ship already docked there (no trip). No requires.bid: what the bid does not take is stored, so the route stays open when the 1 cr bid is drained; ionized_neon is no reserve good (game/reserve.tsv, needs.tsv). standing: XP work, never judged on its pay. Three crafts beside it (argon, neon, oxygen) split the 34 ships over three bids.
